description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to managing ranges on a virtual ring for distributed systems, specifically 'RingRange' and its implementations, used in Orleans runtime.

classes.name: SingleRange
classes.description: Implements a contiguous range on a ring, providing range checks, merging, and utilities for range size and percentage.

classes.name: RangeFactory
classes.description: Contains static methods and constants for creating and managing ring ranges, including full ranges, subranges, and range unions.

classes.name: GeneralMultiRange
classes.description: Represents a non-overlapping collection of multiple ring ranges, allowing range union and overlap detection.

classes.name: EquallyDividedMultiRange
classes.description: Utility class to divide ranges into equal subranges.

methods.name: InRange
methods.description: Checks if a value (uint or GrainId) is contained within the range.

methods.name: CreateRange
methods.description: Creates a custom range between specified begin and end points.

methods.name: CreateRange (List overload)
methods.description: Creates a union of multiple ranges.

methods.name: GetEquallyDividedSubRange
methods.description: Divides a range into equal parts and returns the subrange at a specific index.
